warn.initial_password_in_env: ADMIN_INITIAL_PASSWORD is still set in .env — remove it after the admin password was changed.
warn.cross_fs_data_dir: DATA_DIR is on a different filesystem than STORAGE_ROOT: Recycle Bin and uploads use copy+delete.
warn.swap_low: Swap is below 1 GB ({{swap}}); large jobs may run out of memory.
warn.disk_low: Free disk space is below 10 % ({{free}} of {{total}}).
warn.quota_over_disk: The quota sum ({{quotaSum}}) exceeds the disk capacity ({{diskTotal}}).
warn.sevenzip_password_argv: 7-Zip receives passwords through command arguments (visible in the process list).
warn.admin_browse_enabled: ADMIN_CAN_BROWSE_USERS is on: admins can open other users' folders (every access is audited).

users.title: Users
users.homeWarning: Existing folder reused — check its contents

toast.deleteQueued: Deletion of {{username}} runs as a task.
toast.homeExists: The folder {{username}} already exists in storage and will be reused at first login.

form.usernameHint: 3–32 characters: lower-case letters, digits, _ or -. Cannot be changed.
form.passwordHint: The user must change it at first login.

errors.contains_username: The password must not contain the username.
errors.last_admin: The last active admin cannot be demoted, disabled or deleted.
errors.self: Not possible on your own account.

passwordOnce.title: Temporary password for {{username}}
passwordOnce.body: This password is shown only once. Copy it and hand it over; the user must change it at login.

delete.title: Delete user {{username}}
delete.body: Type the username to confirm. All sessions are revoked and the user's share links stop working.
delete.archiveHint: The folder moves to .system/deleted-users/{{username}}-<time> (with Recycle Bin and versions); the username becomes free again.
delete.purgeHint: Folder, Recycle Bin, versions, thumbnails and related rows are removed. The username is free after 30 days.

confirm.disableBody: Active sessions are revoked and the user's share links stop working until re-enabled.
confirm.revokeBody: Every session of this user is revoked; they have to log in again.
confirm.resetBody: The old password stops working, all sessions are revoked and a new temporary password is shown once.
confirm.resetTotpBody: The TOTP secret and recovery codes are deleted and every session is revoked; the user signs in without a code next time and can enrol again from the profile.

browse.banner: You are viewing the folder of {{username}} as admin. Every access is written to the audit log.
browse.notFound: The user's folder does not exist yet (created at first login).

settings.title: System settings
settings.intro: Values here override .env without a restart. Untouched keys use the env value or the default.

key.share_require_password: Require a password on public links

errors.relation: Conflicts with another setting (chunk ≤ upload limit, remote ≤ upload limit, absolute ≥ idle).
errors.read_only: This key cannot be changed here.

logo.title: Logo
logo.hint: PNG up to 512 KB. Shown in the sidebar and on the login page.
logo.none: No logo yet; the application name is used as a text logo.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.empty: No audit entries for this filter.

shares.title: Shares
shares.revokeBody: The link/access stops at once and {{owner}} cannot re-enable it. The owner and recipients are notified.

maint.title: Maintenance
maint.label: Label (optional, never rotated)
maint.confirmForce: Every item in EVERY user's Recycle Bin is deleted permanently, including items that have not expired. This cannot be undone.
maint.confirmPrune: The least recently used thumbnails are removed until the cache is below 2 GB.

confirm.recalc_quota: Recalculate every user's quota usage by walking their folders. This can take a while on large storage.
confirm.clear_thumbs: Every cached thumbnail is removed and rendered again when needed.
confirm.clean_uploads: Remove abandoned uploads (> 24 h), remote download leftovers and temporary archives.
confirm.purge_trash: Permanently delete Recycle Bin items past their retention.
confirm.integrity_check: Look for folders without an account, accounts without a folder and broken references (read-only).
confirm.backup_db: Copy the database (VACUUM INTO) to DATA_DIR/backups; the last 7 automatic backups are kept.
confirm.prune_logs: Delete activity, share access and audit logs past retention.

desc.recalc_quota: Aligns quota with the real folder contents.
desc.clear_thumbs: Thumbnail cache; pruned weekly (LRU) above 2 GB.
desc.clean_uploads: Abandoned tus uploads, remote downloads, temporary archives.
desc.integrity_check: Orphan folders, accounts without a folder, broken references.
desc.backup_db: Consistent SQLite copy; keeps the last 7.
desc.prune_logs: Retention of activity, share access and audit logs.
